scope: Review five user-supplied Android camera-mode recognition screenshots, record the user's camera capture report, and compare the current public scanner bundle.

phone_flow.device: Android phone based on visible status/navigation UI

recognition_summary.pending_reason_visible: 營養來源不相容的項目未計入合計；熟肉塊因辨識信心過低而待確認。

comparison_with_batch_67.interpretation: Visible candidate, match, and portion outputs differ between the two screenshot batches. The screenshots do not establish identical source-image bytes, framing, or capture conditions, so this is not a controlled same-image repeatability or accuracy measurement.

ui_findings.finding: The first screenshot selects 拍照 and shows a recognition result, but the result page itself has no shutter preview or captured-source image and still offers 啟動相機.
ui_findings.interpretation: The user explicitly reports taking the photo with the camera, so the bounded camera smoke is recorded as user-attested. The screenshot set alone cannot independently establish that the displayed result came from that shutter event.

ui_findings.finding: The page still shows the Gemini + TFDA badge and 已辨識 2 項食物 heading while the details show a USDA-labeled eggplant and six pending candidates.
ui_findings.interpretation: The current public scanner HTML and bundle match the locally exported corrected build and do not contain the visible legacy badge/heading literals. The phone screenshot's capture time, cached HTML/JS, and actual loaded asset are unavailable, so the mismatch is consistent with a stale/captured-earlier browser view but its exact cause is unverified.

interpretation_limits: User report plus camera-selected result screenshots are a bounded smoke report, not an independently replayable camera E2E trace.
The visible TFDA and USDA reference labels do not prove live provider API calls; Tavily use is not visible.
Confidence values are model output fields, not calibrated proof of food identity or nutrition accuracy.
Nutrition values are database references scaled by vision-estimated weights, not measured ground truth.
The visible add-record button does not prove whether it was pressed or whether a write succeeded.
Screenshots do not reveal runtime model provider, app request/retry counts, token usage, cost, Tavily/USDA calls, or profile/meal database writes.
next_bounded_action: Treat the user-reported camera recognition smoke as complete. On the next phone UI check, force-reload the existing HTTPS scanner and verify the corrected source/count wording before scanning; do not enable production nutrition fallback or write profile/meal data.
